question: Take the gender split from the 2011 Bulgarian census about those who have completed tertiary education. Subtract the smaller number from the larger number, then return the difference in thousands of women. So if there were 30.1 thousand more men, you'd give "30.1"

mistake_reason: WebSurfer returned structured data in the wrong format: single quotes, and a non-JSON numeric with a comma as the decimal separator ('men': 556,9). This FM-4.4 formatting error caused the downstream parser to fail strict parsing and fall back to coercing numbers to integers, truncating decimals and yielding a wrong computed difference (235 instead of the correct 234.9).
